book.name: 1 Kolɛŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù fwe wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Kolɛŋ le

content: Saaka kune mwɛɛ munjile mù ba gekintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le

Nlé njɛ̂mɛ mɛɛse kune mwɛɛ munjile mù bamii le bo ge bintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le. Le nchiɛɛŋ no ba duu lɛ besabɛŋ bachii kɛme bvufee. Bvunɛ bvufee taŋlo bvu ge muh bɛ̂ɛŋse nyu ye. Geenɛ, kiŋkoŋɛ to ki joone lo.
Nɛ muh ja wu kwaji lɛ wu kee mwɛɛ, tu gɛ wu kee no wu be kɛme ki wu kêe gɛ.
Geenɛ, muh nɛ koŋe Nyo, Nyo kêe wu.
Noo, fi kune mwɛɛ munjile mù ba ge kintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le, besabɛŋ kee lɛ gɛ banyo banɛ nyume lo fiɛɛ gɛ. Nyo le gɛh wu mumwaa, gɛ wumu ka nyume yu gɛ.
Bamii bamu jode lɛ banyo bamu le yu fɛwe kɛnɛ fɛkuu fɛnɛ. Le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bamii jode lɛ banyo le wesee, bachiji kikwɛɛ nyume tɛ wesee.

Mo no bo jode noo fɛ besabɛŋ le Nyo mɛ gɛh wumaa. Le wu wù le Chiji wese besabɛŋ wù gɛ̀ fɛ mwɛɛ munchii. Besabɛŋ chee nyu njɛ wu. Chiji Kikwɛɛ mɛ gɛh tɛ wumaa wù le Jiso Kletu. Le wu wù ba gɛ̀ fɛ mwɛɛ munchii fede yi chiaaŋ ye le, besabɛŋ kɛme tɛ kinche fede yi ye ye le.

Finɛ le fiɛɛ gɛ nyu bamii bachii a besabɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ ba kee gɛ. Bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ shee bo gee bintanyɛ fɛ banyo bayu le bo jade bo doo bo jii kfuu chi mumwɛɛ mwɛɛ munjile mɛɛse bo kwaji gɛ lɛ bo baaŋ bo jii nyume mwɛɛ mù ba le ba ge kintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo bayu le. Muntele muboo mù wɛɛyi mo mu sage bo lɛ mwɛɛ munjile muyu le mu chɛŋɛ bɛ bo.
Geenɛ bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ taŋlo mwɛɛ munjile to bɛ besabɛŋ mbebe Nyo le gɛ. Besabɛŋ baaŋ ji gɛ, fifiɛɛ kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ ki fi gê gɛ. Besabɛŋ ji, yeye gɛ nyû yu gɛ.
Fiɛɛ fi le, le gɛh lɛ bɛŋ ba kee mwɛɛ munɛ yɛ̂ne keefɛ muh jâ wu jo bvuŋga bvù wu kɛme ki wu gê fiɛɛ fì wu koŋe yu, wu ge nyume fiɛɛ fì mwa bwee wù wɛɛyi baŋsɛ yu wu gwe lo gɛ.
Nɛ wuwɛɛ muh wù fitele wɛɛyi yɛŋ wo wù kee mwɛɛ, jii mwɛɛ kijusɛ kì ba gee bintanyɛ fɛ banyo le, wu gɛ koŋ tɛ ki wu jî mwɛɛ munjile mù bo gee bintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le gɛ?
Nɛ wu ge noo, tu wo wù kee mwɛɛ le wo chɛŋɛ wa bɛ mwa bwoo wù wɛɛyi wunɛ wù Kletu gɛ̀ kwe nje wu.
Fiɛɛ fì wo ge finɛ mo nyume kimbefɛ wo ge, wo chɛŋɛ bɛ fitele fi mwa bwoo wù wɛɛyi, kimbefɛ kiyu kinɛ le wo ge nyu fɛ Kletu le.
Noo, nɛ fi le lɛ fiɛɛ fì njii, fi chɛŋe bɛ mwa bwɛɛŋ, ŋgɛ ŋka n'yu ŋkûŋ nyaŋ le gɛ, wu lɛ keefɛ wu gwê gɛ.
